headline: Xbox prices jump as memory chip costs surge
summary: Microsoft raised UK Series X pricing from £500 to £670 and Series S from £300 to £430; it says storage and memory costs have risen sharply.
script: Microsoft has raised Xbox prices worldwide. In Britain, Series X jumps from five hundred to six hundred and seventy pounds, while Series S rises to four hundred and thirty. The company blames surging memory and storage costs.
